pipeline_name: SIH26138 Green Fleet Data Ingestion Engine

datasets.title: EMSA THETIS-MRV 2022 Annual Emission Reports
datasets.license: European Union Public Data / Commission Decision 2011/833/EU
datasets.cleaning_rules: Extracted numerical fields, filtered positive fuel/distance/sea-time, removed target-leakage columns.

datasets.title: EMSA THETIS-MRV 2023 Annual Emission Reports
datasets.license: European Union Public Data / Commission Decision 2011/833/EU
datasets.cleaning_rules: Strictly independent predictors extracted: ship_type, time_at_sea_hours, technical efficiency (EEDI/EIV/EEXI), ice_class. Zero target-derived features.

datasets.title: United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations
datasets.publisher: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (UNECE)
datasets.observation_grain: Global Port Geographic Entity (coordinates and code list). Terminal-level shore power and grid intensity are curated operational assumptions.

datasets.title: Eurostat Maritime Transport Statistics - Goods Handled in Main Ports
datasets.observation_grain: Calibrated corridor trade flow volume assumptions based on Eurostat port-pair statistics.

datasets.title: IMO MEPC 81 / FuelEU Maritime Lifecycle GHG Emission Factors
datasets.observation_grain: Fuel Grade / Lifecycle Pathway (WTT, TTW, LHV, GWP100 CH4=28, N2O=265)

temporal_holdout_audit.imputation_policy: Imputation statistics (medians/modes) and scalers fit STRICTLY on 2022 training partition to prevent lookahead leakage into 2023.
